question.text: P/E (Price to Earnings) is used for:

answer.text: Relative valuation — comparing to peers or history

explanation.text: The Logic: P/E = how much investors pay per unit of earnings. Used to compare valuation across peers or over time. The Trap: P/E is a multiple, not an intrinsic-value measure. Cross-Exam Context: Core. Manager's Pro-Tip: Forward P/E (based on expected earnings) is more predictive than trailing; adjust for cyclicality.
